correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the centered y_i=a_i(x_i-x_i*) and scaled-dual sweep, triangular row reductions, R_{i+1}-R_i=(lambda-1)y_i, cyclic bidiagonal determinant and removable lambda=1 factor, establishing the full (n+1)-degree polynomial including zero multiplicity. Direct Schur inequalities establish n=3 convergence at all positive penalties. Independent exact-rational matrices and characteristic polynomials were computed for n=2..5 under multiple permutations. The finite computation is corroboration, not the proof for arbitrary n.
residual_risks: The theorem excludes variable-order or randomly permuted sweeps, overrelaxation, and general constraint matrices.
All-n identity is established by symbolic determinant reduction; numerical rational checks only cover finite n.
